ada_2026_soc_sec6.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026 - Section 6: Glycemic Goals and Hypoglycemia
ada_2026_soc_sec6.notes: Hypoglycemia levels (Level 1 <70 mg/dL, Level 2 <54 mg/dL), CGM metrics, and hypoglycemia frequency screening.

ada_2026_soc_sec5.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026 - Section 5: Facilitating Positive Health Behaviors
ada_2026_soc_sec5.notes: Psychosocial screening, diabetes distress, and adherence barriers.

ada_2026_soc_sec12.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026 - Section 12: Retinopathy, Neuropathy, and Foot Care
ada_2026_soc_sec12.notes: Comprehensive foot evaluation, peripheral neuropathy, and early ulcer identification.

aha_acc_2025_hypertension.title: 2025 AHA/ACC Clinical Practice Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults
aha_acc_2025_hypertension.notes: Standardized home BP measurement protocol (5-minute rest, arm support, validated cuff), crisis thresholds, and medication-induced hypertension.

idf_dar_2021_ramadan.title: IDF-DAR Diabetes and Ramadan: Practical Guidelines 2021
idf_dar_2021_ramadan.notes: Risk stratification during fasting, pre-dawn meal timing, hypoglycemia symptoms while fasting, and criteria for breaking the fast.

nice_ng28_t2d.title: NICE Guideline NG28: Type 2 Diabetes in Adults: Management
nice_ng28_t2d.notes: Sick-day rules during acute intercurrent illness, fluid maintenance, and ketone monitoring alert triggers.

nice_ng136_hypertension.title: NICE Guideline NG136: Hypertension in Adults: Diagnosis and Management
nice_ng136_hypertension.notes: Postural hypotension screening, target-organ damage red flags, and associated symptom evaluation.

nice_cg138_patient_experience.title: NICE Clinical Guideline CG138: Patient Experience in Adult NHS Services
nice_cg138_patient_experience.notes: Person-centered communication, open-ended free-text elicitation, and shared decision making.

phq2_kroenke_2003.title: Patient Health Questionnaire-2 (PHQ-2) - Kroenke et al., 2003 (Public Domain)
phq2_kroenke_2003.notes: Two-item screener for depressed mood and anhedonia over the past 2 weeks.

diabetes_distress_dds2.title: Diabetes Distress Screening Items (Adapted DDS-2 Framework)
diabetes_distress_dds2.notes: Feeling overwhelmed by the demands of living with diabetes.

clinical_team_illustrative.title: ChronicCare AI Decision Support Prototype - Clinical Team Illustrative Rule
clinical_team_illustrative.notes: Illustrative threshold or question written for prototype decision support; requires formal clinician review and approval.
